segments.text: CNN has decided not to run a Donald Trump endorsed campaign ad after the network decided it

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: The 32nd Advertisement paid for by Trump's campaign targeted Joe Biden's conduct toward

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Ukraine while he served as Vice President, while also referring to CNN personalities, Don Lemon,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Chris Cuomo, and Jim Acosta as media laptops.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: A CNN spokesperson spoke to THR saying the ad does not meet the network's advertising

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: standards adding, in addition to disparaging CNN and its journalists, the ad makes assertions

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: that have been proven demonstrably false by various news outlets, including CNN.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: However, despite CNN's rejection, the president posted the advertisement onto his Twitter

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: page last week, along with the caption, I'm draining this while.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Now, this is not the first time CNN has rejected a Trump campaign ad.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Back in 2017, the network refused to run a Trump approved ad called, let President Trump

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: his job, which criticized the media and specifically called out Lemon as well as Anderson Cooper.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Stay up to date on the story, hit the THR.com, and until next time, the Hollywood Reporter
